title: Diana Schumann(2017),Public Perception of CO2 Pipelines
method_summary: Original study:2013 telephone survey of1000 German adults with landline connections; descriptive and inductive statistics; self-reported willingness to protest and acceptance factors. Not an intervention or observed permitting/investment-time study.
scope_limit: Representativeness assessed against microcensus with differences in professional qualifications/household sizes; results do not causally estimate effects on permit speed.
